34700.meaning1: net of the teaching; net of Dhamma

examples.text: ko nāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, ānanda, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ atthajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, dhammajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, brahmajālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, diṭṭhijālan'ti'pi naṃ dhārehi, anuttaro saṅgāmavijayo'ti'pi naṃ dhārehī'ti.
uṭṭhānavato satīmato, sucikammassa nisammakārino, saññatassa dhammajīvino, appamattassa yaso'bhivaḍḍhati.
pakkamissañ'ca nāḷāto, ko'dha nāḷāya vacchati, bandhantī itthirūpena, samaṇe dhammajīvino.

34702.meaning1: who knows the teaching; who knows the Dhamma; who understands reality

examples.text: satta sappurisadhammā, idh'āvuso, bhikkhu dhammaññū ca hoti atthaññū ca attaññū ca mattaññū ca kālaññū ca parisaññū ca puggalaññū ca.

34704.meaning1: firmly established in the Dhamma; righteous; just; moral; virtuous
34704.synonym: dhammika, dhammiya, dhammī, sīlavatī, sīlavant, sugatī
34704.commentary: (SNa) dhammaṭṭhā sīlasampannā'ti tasmiṃ dhamme ṭhitattā tena'pi sīlena sampannattā dhammaṭṭhā sīlasampannā. (DHPa) dhammaṭṭhan'ti navavidhalok'uttaradhamme ṭhitaṃ, sacchikata-lok'uttaradhamman'ti attho. (SNPa) dhammaṭṭho'ti catusaccadhamme ṭhito.

examples.text: sīladassanasampannaṃ, dhammaṭṭhaṃ saccavedinaṃ, attano kamma kubbānaṃ, taṃ jano kurute piyaṃ.
kesaṃ divā ca ratto ca, sadā puññaṃ pavaḍḍhati, dhammaṭṭhā sīlasampannā, ke janā saggagāmino'ti.

34705.meaning1: firmly established in and connected with the Dhamma
34705.commentary: (ANa) dhammaṭṭhapaṭisaṃyuttā'ti yā ca dhamme ṭhitena kathitakathā, sā dhammaṭṭhā c'eva hoti tena ca dhammena paṭisaṃyuttā'ti dhammaṭṭhapaṭisaṃyuttā.

examples.text: sace c'assa kathākāmo, kālam'aññāya paṇḍito, dhammaṭṭhapaṭisaṃyuttā, yā ariyacaritā kathā.

34707.meaning1: regularity of natural principles; stability of the Dhamma

examples.text: api ca samaṇo gotamo bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ tathaṃ paṭipadaṃ paññapeti dhammaṭṭhitataṃ dhammaniyāmataṃ.

34709.meaning1: knowledge of the stability of the Dhamma
34709.meaning2: knowledge of relationship of ideas or states, knowledge of structure of ideas or states (term for dependent origination)
34709.commentary: (SNa) dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇan'ti paccay'ākāre ñāṇaṃ. paccay'ākāro hi dhammānaṃ pavattiṭṭhitikāraṇattā dhammaṭṭhitīti vuccati, ettha ñāṇaṃ dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṃ, etass'eva chabbidhassa ñāṇassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ. (SNa) dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇan'ti vipassanāñāṇaṃ, taṃ paṭhamataraṃ uppajjati.

examples.text: asati jātiyā n'atthi jarāmaraṇan'ti ñāṇaṃ, yam'pi'ssa taṃ dhammaṭṭhitiñāṇaṃ tam'pi khayadhammaṃ vayadhammaṃ virāgadhammaṃ nirodhadhamman'ti ñāṇaṃ.

34710.meaning1: reflection on the Dhamma; (comm) right intention
34710.commentary: (ANa) dhammatakkapurejavan'ti dhammatakko vuccati sammāsaṅkappo, so ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅ'gamo hoti aññāvimokkhassā'ti dhammatakkapurejavo.

examples.text: upekkhāsatisaṃsuddhaṃ, dhammatakkapurejavaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūmi, avijjāya pabhedanaṃ.

34711.meaning1: headed by reflection on the teaching; with thoughts about the Dhamma leading the way; (comm) preceded by right view or right intention; (or) initial phase of vipassanā
34711.commentary: (NIDD2) dhammatakkapurejavan'ti dhammatakko vuccati sammāsaṅkappo. so ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅ'gamo hoti aññāvimokkhassā'ti, evam'pi dhammatakkapurejavaṃ. atha vā, dhammatakko vuccati sammādiṭṭhi. sā ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅ'gamo hoti aññāvimokkhassā'ti, evam'pi dhammatakkapurejavaṃ. atha vā, dhammatakko vuccati catunnaṃ maggānaṃ pubbabhāgavipassanā. sā ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅ'gamo hoti aññāvimokkhassā'ti, evam'pi dhammatakkapurejavaṃ. (SNPa) dhammatakkapurejavan'ti iminā tasmiṃ catutthajjhānavimokkhe ṭhatvā jhān'aṅgāni vipassitvā adhigataṃ arahattavimokkhaṃ vadati. arahattavimokkhassa hi maggasampayuttasammāsaṅkapp'ādi-bhedo dhammatakko purejavo hoti. ten'āha, dhammatakkapurejavan'ti.

examples.text: upekkhāsatisaṃsuddhaṃ, dhammatakkapurejavaṃ, aññāvimokkhaṃ pabrūmi, avijjāya pabhedanan'ti.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, taṇhā? cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, taṇhākāyā, rūpataṇhā, saddataṇhā, gandhataṇhā, rasataṇhā, phoṭṭhabbataṇhā, dhammataṇhā. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, taṇhā.
rūpataṇhā… saddataṇhā… gandhataṇhā… rasataṇhā… phoṭṭhabbataṇhā… dhammataṇhā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati

34713.meaning1: this is natural (for); this is the nature (of); this is the character (of); this is normal (for)

examples.text: sīlavato, bhikkhave, sīlasampannassa na cetanāya karaṇīyaṃ, avippaṭisāro me uppajjatū'ti. dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, yaṃ sīlavato sīlasampannassa avippaṭisāro uppajjati.

dhammatā esā, bhikkhave, diṭṭhisampannassa puggalassa, kiñ'c'āpi tathārūpiṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati, yathārūpāya āpattiyā vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyati, atha kho naṃ khippam'eva satthari vā viññūsu vā sabrahmacārīsu deseti vivarati uttānīkaroti, desetvā vivaritvā uttānīkatvā āyatiṃ saṃvaraṃ āpajjati.
sabbe saddhammagaruno, vihaṃsu viharanti ca, tathā'pi viharissanti, esā buddhāna dhammatā.
tassā hi nāma, āvuso, bāhirāya pathavīdhātuyā tāva mahallikāya aniccatā paññāyissati, khayadhammatā paññāyissati, vayadhammatā paññāyissati, vipariṇāmadhammatā paññāyissati.

34715.meaning1: universal law; nature of the Dhamma

examples.text: uttamaṃ dhammataṃ patto, sabbaloke anatthiko, ādittā'va gharā mutto, maraṇasmiṃ na socati.

34717.meaning2: natural form; i.e. stones, trees, etc.

34718.meaning1: well investigated according to character; thoroughly scrutinized regarding qualities
34718.commentary: (MNa) dhammatāsusamanniṭṭho'ti dhammatāya susamanniṭṭho, sabhāven'eva suṭṭhu samannesito hotī'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tathāgate dhammasamannesanā hoti. evañ'ca pana tathāgato dhammatāsusamanniṭṭho hotī'ti.

34720.meaning2: being legal or valid, being according to the rule

34721.meaning2: discourse on the meaning of the Dhamma

34722.meaning1: thief of the Dhamma; who steals the teaching
34722.meaning2: thief of dhamma (who enters the Saṅgha dishonestly)

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā susimo bhagavato pādesu sirasā nipatitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, accayo maṃ, bhante, accagamā yathābālaṃ yathāmūḷhaṃ yathāakusalaṃ, yv'āhaṃ evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye dhammatthenako pabbajito. tassa me, bhante, bhagavā accayaṃ accayato paṭiggaṇhātu āyatiṃ saṃvarāyā'ti.

34723.meaning2: elder in dhamma, one venerable because of his qualities

34724.commentary: (DNa) cattāro'me, bhikkhave, therakaraṇā dhammā. idha, bhikkhave, thero sīlavā hoti, bahussuto hoti, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ lābhī hoti, āsavānaṃ khayā bahussuto hoti, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ lābhī hoti, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh'eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati. ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro therakaraṇā dhammā'ti (a. ni. 4.22). evaṃ vuttesu dhammesu ekena vā anekehi vā samannāgato dhammathero nāma.

examples.text: tayo therā, jātithero, dhammathero, sammutithero.

34725.meaning1: who sees the truth; who perceives reality
34725.commentary: (THa) dhammadaso'ti tam'āhu tathattan'ti taṃ tathabhāvaṃ sammāpaṭipannaṃ yāthāvato dhammadassī'ti paṇḍitā āhu.

examples.text: na hi socati bhikkhu kadāci, maggajino sammāpaṭipanno, kittiñ'ca sukhañ'ca anubhoti, dhammadaso'ti tam'āhu pahit'attaṃ.

34726.meaning1: seeing the Dhamma; understanding the teaching
34726.commentary: (SNa) dhammadassanan'ti padena dhamme pasādo gahito'ti evaṃ cattāri sot'āpattiy'aṅgāni vuttāni.

examples.text: tasmā saddhañ'ca sīlañ'ca, pasādaṃ dhammadassanaṃ, anuyuñjetha medhāvī, saraṃ buddhāna sāsanan'ti.

34727.meaning1: gift of Dhamma; gift of the teaching
34727.commentary: (ANa) dhammadānan'ti idh'ekacco amatapattipaṭipadaṃ kathetvā deti, idaṃ dhammadānaṃ nāma.

examples.text: sabbadānaṃ dhammadānaṃ jināti, sabbarasaṃ dhammaraso jināti, sabbaratiṃ dhammarati jināti, taṇhakkhayo sabbadukkhaṃ jināti.
dve'māni, bhikkhave, dānāni āmisadānañ'ca dhammadānañ'ca. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imesaṃ dvinnaṃ dānānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammadānaṃ.

34728.meaning1: spiritual heir; inheritor of the Dhamma
34728.meaning2: having dhamma as one's inheritance, spiritual heir

examples.text: tassa me tumhe puttā orasā mukhato jātā dhammajā dhammanimmitā dhammadāy'ādā, no āmisadāy'ādā.
tumhe ca me bhikkhave āmisadāy'ādā bhaveyyātha no dhammadāy'ādā, tumhe'pi tena ādiyā bhaveyyātha, āmisadāy'ādā satthusāvakā viharanti, no dhammadāy'ādā'ti

34729.meaningLit: discourse on heirs of the teaching

34730.commentary: (SNa) dhammadinno'ti sattasu janesu eko. buddhakālasmiñ'hi dhammadinno upāsako, visākho upāsako, uggo gahapati, citto gahapati, hatthako āḷavako, cūḷaanāthapiṇḍiko, mahāanāthapiṇḍiko'ti ime satta janā pañcasataupāsakaparivārā ahesuṃ. etesu esa aññataro.

examples.text: atha kho dhammadinno upāsako pañcahi upāsakasatehi saddhiṃ yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

34732.meaning1: name of an arahant nun; great disciple of the Buddha; foremost nun in giving Dhamma talks
34732.notes: Therīgāthā verse 12 (TH1.12, TH12) is attributed to her.

examples.text: atha kho visākho upāsako yena dhammadinnā bhikkhunī ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā dhammadinnaṃ bhikkhuniṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ bhikkhunīnaṃ dhammakathikānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammadinnā.

34734.meaning1: with Dhamma as one's place of safety; with Dhamma as one's solid ground
34734.meaning2: having the Dhamma as a sound footing

examples.text: dhammadīpā dhammasaraṇā anaññasaraṇā
makkhī dhammaṃ suṇāti makkhapariyuṭṭhito, upārambhacitto dhammaṃ suṇāti randhagavesī, dhammadesake āhatacitto hoti khīlajāto, duppañño hoti jaḷo eḷamūgo, anaññāte aññātamānī hoti.

34736.meaningLit: for the purpose of giving a Dhamma talk

examples.text: atha kho bāhiyassa dārucīriyassa bhagavato imāya saṃkhittāya dhammadesanāya tāva'd'eva anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimucci.
idha no, āvuso, ko viseso, ko adhippayāso, kiṃ nānākaraṇaṃ samaṇassa vā gotamassa amhākaṃ vā, yadidaṃ dhammadesanāya vā dhammadesanaṃ, anusāsaniyā vā anusāsanin'ti?

34740.meaning1: by means of the Dhamma discourse

34741.meaning1: rule about teaching the Dhamma; Pācittiya 7

examples.text: suvijāno bhavaṃ hoti, suvijāno parābhavo, dhammakāmo bhavaṃ hoti, dhammadessī parābhavo.

34744.meaning1: who sees the Dhamma; who understands the reality

examples.text: oghassa nittharaṇ'atthaṃ, anekavihitaṃ maggaṃ akkhāsi, tasmiñ'ce amate akkhāte, dhammaddasā ṭhitā asaṃhīrā.
evaṃ ahaṃ amatadasamhi devatā, tathāgatassanadhivarassa sāvikā, dhammaddasā paṭhamaphale patiṭṭhitā, sot'āpannā na ca pana m'atthi duggati.

34745.commentary: (DNa) dhammaddhajo dhammaketū'ti taṃ dhammaṃ dhajam'iva purakkhatvā ketum'iva ca ukkhipitvā pavattiyā dhammaddhajo dhammaketu ca hutvā'ti attho.

examples.text: tena hi tvaṃ, tāta, dhammaṃ'y'eva nissāya dhammaṃ sakkaronto dhammaṃ garuṃ karonto dhammaṃ mānento dhammaṃ pūjento dhammaṃ apacāyamāno dhammaddhajo dhammaketu dhamm'ādhipateyyo dhammikaṃ rakkh'āvaraṇaguttiṃ saṃvidahassu antojanasmiṃ balakāyasmiṃ khattiyesu anuyantesu brāhmaṇagahapatikesu negamajānapadesu samaṇabrāhmaṇesu migapakkhīsu.

34749.meaning1: who knows the Dhamma by heart
34749.meaning2: who knows the Dhamma by heart

examples.text: na tāvatā dhammadharo, yāvatā bahu bhāsati, yo ca appam'pi sutvāna, dhammaṃ kāyena passati, sa ve dhammadharo hoti, yo dhammaṃ nappamajjati.
bahussuto dhammadharo, bahussuto dhammadharo'ti, bhante, vuccati. kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, bahussuto dhammadharo hotī'ti?

34750.meaning1: nature of reality; way things are
34750.commentary: (MNa) dhammadhātū'ti dhammasabhāvo. sabbaññutaññāṇassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ. taṃ bhagavatā suppaṭividdhaṃ, hatthagataṃ bhagavato.

examples.text: sā hi, rājakumāra, tathāgatassa dhammadhātu suppaṭividdhā yassā dhammadhātuyā suppaṭividdhattā ṭhānaso'v'etaṃ tathāgataṃ paṭibhātī'ti.

34751.commentary: (SNa) cakkhudhātū'ti-ādīsu… tisso manodhātuyo manodhātu, vedan'ādayo tayo khandhā sukhumarūpāni nibbānañ'ca dhammadhātu, sabbam'pi manoviññāṇaṃ manoviññāṇadhātū'ti.

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante. idaṃ kho, gahapati, dhātunānattaṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā, cakkhudhātu, rūpadhātu, cakkhuviññāṇadhātu… manodhātu, dhammadhātu, manoviññāṇadhātu.

34752.meaning1: remembering the teaching; bearing the Dhamma in mind

examples.text: sā'pi nāma, bhikkhave, saddhā n'āhosi, tam'pi nāma, bhikkhave, upasaṅkamanaṃ n'āhosi, sā'pi nāma, bhikkhave, payirupāsanā n'āhosi, tam'pi nāma, bhikkhave, sot'āvadhānaṃ n'āhosi, tam'pi nāma, bhikkhave, dhammassavanaṃ n'āhosi, sā'pi nāma, bhikkhave, dhammadhāraṇā n'āhosi

34753.meaning2: with dhamma as master; guided by dhamma

34754.meaning1: delight in the Dhamma; enjoyment of the Dhamma

examples.text: no ce āsavānaṃ khayaṃ pāpuṇāti, ten'eva dhammarāgena tāya dhammanandiyā pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo tasmā lokā.

34755.grammar: nt loc sg of dhanva, irreg form of dhanvani
34755.meaning1: on dry land; on the shore; on a sandbank

examples.text: anatthasaṃhitaṃ ñatvā, yaṃ kiñci amaraṃ tapaṃ, sabbaṃ n'atth'āvahaṃ hoti, phiy'ārittaṃ'va dhammani.

34757.meaning1: acceptance of the teaching after consideration; approving of the teaching after understanding it
34757.commentary: (ADha) sabbe'pi'ssā te kamm'āyatan'ādayo dhammā nijjhānaṃ khamanti, visesato ca pañcakkhandhasaṅkhātā dhammā punappunaṃ aniccadukkh'ānattavasena nijjhāyamānā taṃ nijjhānaṃ khamantī'ti dhammanijjhānakhantī

examples.text: atthaṃ upaparikkhato dhammā nijjhānaṃ khamanti, dhammanijjhānakkhantiyā sati chando jāyati, chandajāto ussahati, ussahitvā tuleti, tulayitvā padahati, pahit'atto samāno kāyena c'eva paramasaccaṃ sacchikaroti paññāya ca naṃ ativijjha passati.

34758.meaning1: acceptance of the teaching after consideration; approving of the teaching after understanding it
34758.meaning2: choice after pondering over the True Idea (Dhamma); acceptance of the Dhamma as a result of reflection
34758.commentary: (ADha) sabbe'pi'ssā te kamm'āyatan'ādayo dhammā nijjhānaṃ khamanti, visesato ca pañcakkhandhasaṅkhātā dhammā punappunaṃ aniccadukkh'ānattavasena nijjhāyamānā taṃ nijjhānaṃ khamantī'ti dhammanijjhānakhantī

examples.text: yogavihitesu vā kammāyatanesu yogavihitesu vā sippāyatanesu yogavihitesu vā vijjāṭṭhānesu kammassakataṃ vā sacc'ānulomikaṃ vā… viññāṇaṃ aniccan'ti vā, yaṃ evarūpiṃ anulomikaṃ khantiṃ diṭṭhiṃ ruciṃ mutiṃ pekkhaṃ dhammanijjhānakhantiṃ parato assutvā paṭilabhati, ayaṃ vuccati cintāmayā paññā

34759.commentary: (VINt) dhammavasena upacāravasena nimantanā dhammanimantanā'ti pāḷipadassa attho veditabbo. sace pana vadeyyātha, bhante, yen'attho'ti idaṃ saccam'eva vuttaṃ siyā, pavārito'y'eva hoti. yasmā pana pavāretvā'pi adātu'kāmo appavāritaṭṭhāne'y'eva tiṭṭhati, tasmā bhagavā pavārit'āpavāritabhāvaṃ avicāretvā ñātako te, upananda, aññātako'ti ñātakaaññātakabhāvaṃ'y'eva vicāresi.

34760.meaning1: mental representation of phenomena; mental image

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya na dhammanimitt'ānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti na dhammanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ na dhammanimitt'assādavinibandhaṃ na dhammanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ avikkhittaṃ avisaṭan'ti vuccati.

34761.meaning1: expanding of and bondage to the resort that is the representation of mental phenomena
34761.commentary: (SNa) rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā'ti rūpam'eva kilesānaṃ paccay'aṭṭhena nimittaṃ, ārammaṇakiriya-saṅkhāta-nivāsanaṭṭhān'aṭṭhena niketan'ti rūpanimittaniketaṃ. visāro ca vinibandho ca visāravinibandhā. ubhayen'api hi kilesānaṃ patthaṭabhāvo ca vinibandhanabhāvo ca vutto, rūpanimittanikete visāravinibandhā'ti rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā, tasmā rūpanimittaniketamhi uppannena kilesavisārena c'eva kilesabandhanena cā'ti attho.
34761.notes: A difficult term to translate. See CPB note 22. Also see rūpanimittaniketavisāravinibandha.

examples.text: rūpanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā kho, gahapati, niketasārī'ti vuccati. saddanimitta … gandhanimitta… rasanimitta… phoṭṭhabbanimitta… dhammanimitta-niketa-visāra-vinibandhā kho, gahapati, niketasārī'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho, gahapati, niketasārī hoti.

34762.meaning1: bound by gratification to the mental representation of phenomena

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammanimitt'ānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti, dhammanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ dhamma-nimitt'assāda-vinibandhaṃ dhammanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.

34763.meaning1: bound with a chain to the gratification from the mental representation of phenomena

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammanimitt'ānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti, dhammanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ dhamma-nimitt'assāda-vinibandhaṃ dhammanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.

34764.meaning1: bound by the gratification from the mental representation of phenomena

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhuno… manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammanimitt'ānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti, dhammanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ dhamma-nimitt'assāda-vinibandhaṃ dhammanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.

34765.meaning1: following the mental representations of phenomena

examples.text: manasā dhammaṃ viññāya dhammanimitt'ānusārī viññāṇaṃ hoti, dhammanimitt'assādagadhitaṃ dhamma-nimitt'assāda-vinibandhaṃ dhammanimitt'assāda-saṃyojana-saṃyuttaṃ bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati. evaṃ kho āvuso, bahiddhā viññāṇaṃ vikkhittaṃ visaṭan'ti vuccati.

34766.meaning1: created by the Dhamma; fashioned from the Dhamma

examples.text: tassa me tumhe puttā orasā mukhato jātā dhammajā dhammanimmitā dhammadāy'ādā, no āmisadāy'ādā.

34768.meaning1: invariance of natural principles; orderliness of the teaching

examples.text: api ca samaṇo gotamo bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ tathaṃ paṭipadaṃ paññapeti dhammaṭṭhitataṃ dhammaniyāmataṃ.
evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ. tasmā't'iha te, gahapati, evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ, na dhammaṃ upādiyissāmi na ca me dhammanissitaṃ viññāṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti. evañ'hi te, gahapati, sikkhitabbaṃ.

34772.meaning2: who follows dhamma; who develops understanding

34774.meaning1: guidelines of the teaching; Dhamma as a guide
34774.meaning2: leading rope, guiding rope, that is dhamma
34774.commentary: (MNa) dhammanetti samanumajjitabbā'ti dhammarajju anumajjitabbā ñāṇena ghaṃsitabbā upaparikkhitabbā. sā pan'esā dhammanetti, iti kho, vaccha, ime dasa dhammā akusalā dasa dhammā kusalā'ti evaṃ mahāvacchagottasutte (ma. ni. 2.194) āgatā'ti vuttā. sā eva vā hotu, yo vā idha dhammo'ti ca vinayo ca vutto.

examples.text: teh'ānanda, bhikkhūhi sabbeh'eva samaggehi sannipatitabbaṃ. sannipatitvā dhammanetti samanumajjitabbā. dhammanettiṃ samanumajjitvā yathā tattha sameti tathā taṃ adhikaraṇaṃ vūpasametabbaṃ.

34775.meaning1: inference about the Dhamma; understanding about the teaching (for someone regarding someone)
34775.commentary: (DNa) dhamm'anvayo'ti dhammassa paccakkhato ñāṇassa anuyogaṃ anugantvā uppannaṃ anumānañāṇaṃ nayaggāho vidito. sāvakapāramīñāṇe ṭhatvāva iminā'va ākārena jānāmi bhagavā'ti vadati. therassa hi nayaggāho appamāṇo apariyanto. yathā sabbaññutaññāṇassa pamāṇaṃ vā pariyanto vā n'atthi, evaṃ dhammasenāpatino nayaggāhassa. tena so iminā evaṃvidho, iminā anuttaro satthā'ti jānāti. therassa hi nayaggāho sabbaññutaññāṇagatiko eva. (MNa) tattha anvetī'ti anvayo, jānāti, anubujjhatī'ti attho. dhammassa anvayo dhamm'anvayo

examples.text: evam'eva kho me, bhante, dhamm'anvayo vidito, ye te, bhante, ahesuṃ atītam'addhānaṃ arahanto sammāsambuddhā, sabbe te bhagavanto pañca nīvaraṇe pahāya cetaso upakkilese paññāya dubbalīkaraṇe catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supatiṭṭhitacittā sattabojjh'aṅge yathābhūtaṃ bhāvetvā anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambujjhiṃsu.
ayam'pi hi nāma, sāriputta, sunakkhattassa moghapurisassa mayi dhamm'anvayo na bhavissati, iti'pi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho

34776.meaning2: necessity of an idea or principle

34777.meaning1: teaching the Dhamma; communicating the teaching

examples.text: so tāya dhammapaññattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, bhikkhu paññattibahulo, no dhammavihārī.

34778.meaning2: false representation of the teachings or the rule

34779.commentary: (ADha) dhammapaṭisanthāro'ti dhammassa appaṭilābhena attanā saha paresaṃ chiddaṃ yathā pihitaṃ hoti paṭicchannaṃ, evaṃ dhammena paṭisantharaṇaṃ.

examples.text: katame dve? āmisapaṭisanthāro ca dhammapaṭisanthāro ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve paṭisanthārā.

34780.meaning1: analytical understanding of natural conditions; discriminative understanding of the teaching

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu atthapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, niruttipaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhati.

34781.meaning1: attained analytical understanding of natural conditions; (comm) reached a discriminative understanding of the teaching
34781.commentary: (VINa) na dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto'ti pāḷidhamme paṭisambhidāpatto na hoti. (PYt) pāḷidhamme'ti iminā dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto'ti ettha dhammasarūpaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: katamehi pañcahi? atthapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, dhammapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, niruttipaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, paṭibhānapaṭisambhidāpatto hoti, yāni tāni sabrahmacārīnaṃ ucc'āvacāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni tattha dakkho hoti analaso tatr'upāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ

34783.meaning1: experiencing the teaching; sensitive to the Dhamma; (comm) knowing the text

examples.text: tassa atthapaṭisaṃvedino dhammapaṭisaṃvedino pāmojjaṃ jāyati, pamuditassa pīti jāyati, pītimanassa kāyo passambhati, passaddhakāyo sukhaṃ vedeti, sukhino cittaṃ samādhiyati. idaṃ paṭhamaṃ vimutt'āyatanaṃ.

34785.meaning1: verse of the teaching; line of Dhamma; religious saying
34785.meaning2: line or stanza of the Dhamma
34785.commentary: (DHPa) ko dhammapadaṃ sudesitan'ti yathāsabhāvato kathitattā sudesitaṃ sattatiṃsa-bodhipakkhiyadhamma-saṅkhātaṃ dhammapadaṃ (DHPa) dhammapadan'ti atthasādhakaṃ khandh'ādipaṭisaṃyuttaṃ, cattār'imāni paribbājakā dhammapadāni. katamāni cattāri? anabhijjhā paribbājakā dhammapadaṃ, abyāpādo paribbājakā dhammapadaṃ, sammāsati paribbājakā dhammapadaṃ, sammāsamādhi paribbājakā dhammapadan'ti

examples.text: ko imaṃ pathaviṃ vicessati, yamalokañ'ca imaṃ sadevakaṃ, ko dhammapadaṃ sudesitaṃ, kusalo puppham'iva pacessati.
yo ca gāthā sataṃ bhāse, anatthapadasaṃhitā, ekaṃ dhammapadaṃ seyyo, yaṃ sutvā upasammati.

34786.meaning1: path of Dhamma; way of the teaching; (comm) state of awakening
34786.commentary: (SNa) dānā ca kho dhammapadaṃ'va seyyo'ti dānato nibbānasaṅkhātaṃ dhammapadam'eva seyyo.

examples.text: saddhā hi dānaṃ bahudhā pasatthaṃ, dānā ca kho dhammapadaṃ'va seyyo, pubbe ca hi pubbatare ca santo, nibbānam'ev'ajjhagamuṃ sapaññā'ti.
bhayadassi vā [bhayadassāvī dha. pa. 32 dhammapade'pi]

tato paraṃ jātakaṃ, niddeso, paṭisambhidāmaggo, apadānaṃ, suttanipāto, khuddakapāṭho, dhammapadaṃ, udānaṃ, itivuttakaṃ, vimānavatthu, petavatthu, theragāthā, therīgāthā'ti imaṃ tantiṃ saṅgāyitvā khuddakagantho nām'āyan'ti ca vatvā abhidhammapiṭakasmiṃ'y'eva saṅgahaṃ āropayiṃsū'ti dīghabhāṇakā vadanti.

34789.commentary: (MNa) dhammapadabyañjanan'ti pāḷiyā padabyañjanaṃ, tassa tassa atthassa byañjanakaṃ akkharaṃ.

examples.text: aññatra asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā, aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā apariyādinnā'y'ev'assa, sāriputta, tathāgatassa dhammadesanā, apariyādinnaṃ'y'ev'assa tathāgatassa dhammapadabyañjanaṃ, apariyādinnaṃ'y'ev'assa tathāgatassa pañhapaṭibhānaṃ.

34790.meaningLit: discourse on aspects of the Dhamma

34791.meaning1: generosity with the teaching; Dhamma sharing

examples.text: katame dve? āmisapariccāgo ca dhammapariccāgo ca. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve pariccāgā.
so tāya dhammapariyattiyā divasaṃ atināmeti, riñcati paṭisallānaṃ, n'ānuyuñjati ajjhattaṃ cetosamathaṃ. ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhu, bhikkhu pariyattibahulo, no dhammavihārī.
nibbedhikapariyāyaṃ vo, bhikkhave, dhammapariyāyaṃ desessāmi. taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmī'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. bhagavā etadavoca.
ko nāmo ayaṃ, bhante, dhammapariyāyo'ti? tasmā't'iha tvaṃ, ānanda, imaṃ dhammapariyāyaṃ madhupiṇḍikapariyāyo tv'eva naṃ dhārehī'ti
katamā dve? āmisapariyeṭṭhi ca dhammapariyeṭṭhi ca. imā kho, bhikkhave, dve pariyeṭṭhiyo.

34795.meaning1: quest for mental phenomena; searching for thoughts
34795.commentary: (SNa) no dhammapariyesanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho'ti evaṃ āgataṃ paṭisedhamattam'eva nānaṃ.

examples.text: dhammadhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaññā, dhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaṅkappo, dhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammacchando, dhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho, dhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariyesanā.

34796.meaning1: quest for Dhamma; searching for the teaching

examples.text: imā kho, bhikkhave, dve pariyesanā. etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, imāsaṃ dvinnaṃ pariyesanānaṃ yadidaṃ dhammapariyesanā'ti.

34797.meaning1: fever for mental phenomena; burning passion for thoughts
34797.commentary: (SNa) no dhammapariyesanaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho'ti evaṃ āgataṃ paṭisedhamattam'eva nānaṃ.

examples.text: dhammadhātuṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaññā, dhammasaññaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammasaṅkappo, dhammasaṅkappaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammacchando, dhammacchandaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariḷāho, dhammapariḷāhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati dhammapariyesanā.

34799.meaning2: lotus ponds in the palace called Dhamma
